reviews.title: Lots of fun!
reviews.text:
This trivia app is awesome. Good facts, and simple to use. Only three problems: the questions in the starter pack repeat themselves so much that I know the answer to them all. Second, the other packs and the books you can be quizzed on are not free. I do understand that this is how you make money, but I like to learn lots about the Bible and only repeating the same questions isn’t how I’d like to learn. Lastly, although there aren’t many ads, it can be frustrating when they appear on the middle of the quiz. Again, I understand that this is how you make money but I would love if you could program the app to have the ads appear once before the quiz and once after the quiz! That way, we get to do our trivia uninterrupted but you guys still get to show the ads. Thank you for this time and otherwise, I love this app! Keep it up 😊

Edit::: I appreciate the new update! You guys added new questions so that it wasn’t repeating them all the time, thank you so much!
